title: Recreate the moment Qatar watched
description: Stand where the 2022 final was decided and recreate one iconic moment from it — the celebration, the lift, the walk. Film it from the stand you can actually reach.

title: Learn what a falconer looks for
description: Find the falcon souq, ask a falconer what makes one bird worth more than another, and explain their answer on camera in your own words.

title: Five things only Souq Waqif sells
description: Find five things in the market you could not buy at home, one from five different sellers. Show each, and say what it is for.

title: Fold a manoushe with the baker
description: Ask a furn baker to teach you the fold. Make one yourself, badly, on camera. Eat it anyway.

title: Six columns, one frame
description: Find the angle where all six standing columns of the Temple of Jupiter line up in one frame. Harder than it sounds. Stay on the visitor paths.

title: Sit with a tree older than your country
description: Find one of the oldest cedars in the grove, sit with it for ten minutes without your phone, then say on camera what you thought about. Stay on the marked paths — the roots are the fragile part.

title: Buy soap where it is still made
description: Find a khan where soap is still cut by hand, and get the maker to explain what goes in it.

title: The kunafa argument
description: Nablus argues about who makes the best kunafa. Ask three people in the old city, get three different answers, then eat at whichever won.

title: The oldest door you will ever stoop through
description: The Door of Humility is deliberately too low to enter upright. Learn why from someone there, and explain it. Film only outside the church, keep silence inside, and do not record anyone at prayer.

title: Four empires, one hillside
description: Sebastia has Roman, Byzantine, Crusader and Ottoman work on one hill. Photograph one piece of each and say how you told them apart.

title: Walk the Siq without looking up
description: Walk the whole gorge to the Treasury with your eyes down, then look up all at once and film your own face doing it.

title: Count what the city hides
description: Photograph the Milky Way from the desert floor. Go with a licensed camp, not alone.

title: Show how big it actually is
description: Every photo of the pyramids fails to convey the scale. Take one that does not. Do not climb anything.

title: Order coffee the way Cairo does
description: Learn the difference between ahwa saada, mazbout and ziyada, order the one you actually want in Arabic, and drink it where you ordered it.

title: The empire everyone forgot
description: Hegra was Nabataean, like Petra, and almost nobody knows it. Visit with a licensed guide and explain one thing the carvings tell you about who was buried there.

title: Where the first mosque stood
description: Learn what makes Quba the first mosque in Islam and explain it in your own words. Dress and behave as the site asks, film only where filming is permitted, and never during prayer.

title: Air conditioning before electricity
description: Find a barjeel wind tower, stand under it, and explain on camera how it cools a room with no power at all.

title: Make the tallest building look small
description: Take one photograph in which the Burj Khalifa is genuinely not the most impressive thing in frame.

title: Find the seam between two faiths
description: Hagia Sophia carries Christian mosaic and Islamic calligraphy in the same room. Photograph one place where both are visible at once, and explain what you are looking at. Observe the rules for visitors and never film during prayer.

title: Haggle, and lose gracefully
description: Negotiate for something small in the Grand Bazaar, pay a fair price, and film the moment you both know the deal is done.

title: Be there when the colour moves
description: Gaudí put warm glass on one side and cold on the other so the interior changes colour through the day. Film the light on the wall, and say what time it was.

title: Follow the water uphill
description: The Generalife's water arrives from far away and moves without pumps. Trace it as far as visitors are allowed and explain how it works.

title: What was under the floor
description: The hypogeum below the arena ran the whole show with lifts and trapdoors. Photograph it and explain one mechanism the Romans used.

title: Let the fishmonger decide lunch
description: Ask a Rialto fishmonger what came in this morning, buy it, and get it cooked somewhere nearby. Film what you were handed and what you ate.

title: CAMARA demo — photograph where you are
description: Take one photograph of your surroundings, outdoors, showing the place you are standing. This quest exists to demonstrate network verification: the photograph is assessed normally, and the four Nokia simulator devices are what change between runs.

title: CAMARA demo — show a building in frame
description: Photograph any building or structure with the sky visible behind it. A second demo quest so the panel can be shown on more than one verification contract.
